verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes a public Data Access API as an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document on SwaggerHub. Its developer-portal reference covers pagination, rate limiting, authentication and versioning, and a community user scripted against the API after launch. The docs.bugsnag.com OpenAPI probe 404s only mean the spec is hosted elsewhere, not that it is absent. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of write/action endpoints for driving the product (the description emphasizes accessing data) and recent independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: SwaggerHub-published OpenAPI 3.0.3 document: info.title "BugSnag - Data Access API"
